scripts.demo: node scripts/make-demo.mjs > demo.sql && wrangler d1 execute biogester --remote --file=demo.sql
scripts.demo:clean: node scripts/make-demo.mjs clean > clean.sql && wrangler d1 execute biogester --remote --file=clean.sql
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute biogester --local --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute biogester --local --file=seed.sql
